timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Big data platform. Just a bigger database, right?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: A bigger attack surface. Pipelines, warehouses, and ML models are all targets.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Ingestion. Validate and encrypt data in transit, authenticate producers, scan for sensitive data.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Encrypt lakes and warehouses. Fine-grained access and column-level masking.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Their broad read access is the real risk. Mask columns and limit rows per role.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Run with least privilege and audit who runs what. Isolate compute from data.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Protect training data, control model access, watch for exfiltration through inference.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Lineage and metadata catalogs. Know where data came from and who touched it.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Privacy-preserving analytics so insights don't leak personal data.
